name: CiteGuard Closed-Loop Failure Learning & Adaptive Verification Benchmark
adjudication_procedure: Independent dual-annotator adjudication with scientific literature ground-truth anchoring. Labels frozen before experimental trials.

cases.question: Can curcumin cure glioblastoma in clinical patients?
cases.claim_text: Curcumin cures aggressive glioblastoma in human clinical cancer patients.

evidence.text: In vitro cell culture assays demonstrate curcumin induces apoptosis in U87 glioblastoma cell lines at 50 micromolar concentrations.
evidence.title: In Vitro Curcumin Apoptosis in U87

cases.ground_truth_rationale: In vitro petri-dish assays on cell lines cannot substantiate curative claims in living human patients; context mismatch.

cases.question: Does artificial sweetener intake cause metabolic syndrome?
cases.claim_text: Artificial sweetener consumption directly causes metabolic syndrome and insulin resistance.

evidence.text: In an observational cohort of 3,500 adults, artificial sweetener intake is statistically associated and correlated with metabolic syndrome markers.
evidence.title: Observational Correlates of Artificial Sweetener Intake

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Observational cohort correlation cannot establish direct physiological causality; requires qualification to associative findings.

cases.question: Does compound X prevent Alzheimer's disease?
cases.claim_text: Compound X completely prevents neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease.
cases.ground_truth_rationale: Zero empirical evidence retrieved from literature; claim confirmation is ungrounded.

cases.question: Does daily aspirin prevent cardiovascular events in healthy elderly?
cases.claim_text: Daily low-dose aspirin reduces cardiovascular events without adverse risk in healthy elderly populations.

evidence.text: Low-dose aspirin reduces ischemic events by 9% in high-risk subsets.
The ASPREE trial demonstrated aspirin did not prolong disability-free survival and significantly elevated major hemorrhage risk.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Direct trial refutation overrules partial support; contradiction signal must trigger REFUTE revision.

cases.question: Does resveratrol extend human lifespan?
cases.claim_text: Resveratrol supplementation significantly extends maximum human lifespan in human clinical populations.

evidence.text: In vitro yeast assays and C. elegans murine models demonstrate resveratrol activates SIRT1 and extends nematode lifespan.
evidence.title: SIRT1 Activation in In Vitro and Nematode Models

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Held-out related case: In vitro / nematode findings cannot support human clinical lifespan extension.

cases.question: Does pembrolizumab improve survival in metastatic melanoma?
cases.claim_text: Pembrolizumab improves overall survival in human clinical cancer patients with metastatic melanoma.

evidence.text: In a randomized phase 3 trial involving 834 human clinical cancer patients with advanced melanoma, pembrolizumab prolonged overall survival compared to ipilimumab.
evidence.title: Phase 3 Trial of Pembrolizumab in Melanoma

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Hard negative: Mentions cancer patients and survival, but is supported by a genuine Phase 3 human clinical trial, not preclinical in vitro assays. Must NOT be rejected.

cases.question: Does coffee drinking prevent depression?
cases.claim_text: Drinking coffee directly causes reduced incidence of clinical depression.

evidence.text: In a prospective observational cohort of nurses, higher caffeinated coffee consumption was statistically correlated with lower depression risk.
evidence.title: Coffee Intake and Depression Risk in Women

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Held-out related case: Observational correlation cannot justify direct causal assertion.

cases.question: Does statin therapy reduce LDL cholesterol in hypercholesterolemia?
cases.claim_text: Atorvastatin administration directly reduces serum LDL cholesterol in hypercholesterolemia.

evidence.text: A double-blind randomized placebo-controlled interventional trial demonstrated that atorvastatin directly causes a 45% reduction in serum LDL-C through HMG-CoA reductase inhibition.
evidence.title: Double-Blind Interventional Trial of Atorvastatin

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Hard negative: Uses causal terminology ('directly causes'), but evidence is a randomized interventional trial directly proving mechanism. Must NOT be downgraded.

cases.question: Does regular aerobic exercise improve cardiorespiratory fitness?
cases.claim_text: Regular aerobic exercise training improves maximal oxygen uptake VO2 max in healthy adults.

evidence.text: Meta-analysis of 42 randomized trials demonstrates that aerobic endurance exercise training significantly increases VO2 max by an average of 3.8 mL/kg/min in healthy adults.
evidence.title: Meta-analysis of Exercise and VO2 Max

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Clean valid support: Peer-reviewed meta-analysis of randomized trials directly proving claim. Must remain SUPPORT with high confidence.

cases.question: Does CRISPR-Cas9 edit targeted genomic DNA sequences?
cases.claim_text: CRISPR-Cas9 endonuclease facilitates targeted double-strand DNA cleavage in eukaryotic genomes.

evidence.text: Engineered Cas9 nucleases paired with synthetic single-guide RNAs induce targeted double-strand breaks at specific genomic loci in eukaryotic cells.
evidence.title: Multiplex Genome Engineering Using CRISPR-Cas Systems

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Clean valid support: Verified molecular biology mechanism directly substantiated.

cases.question: What is the speed of light in vacuum?
cases.claim_text: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 299,792 kilometers per second.

evidence.text: By international agreement and SI definition, the speed of light in vacuum c is exactly 299,792,458 metres per second.
evidence.title: CODATA Recommended Values of Fundamental Physical Constants

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Unrelated physics domain: Must remain completely unaffected by biomedical failure patterns.

cases.question: Does magnetic therapy cure rheumatoid arthritis?
cases.claim_text: Static magnetic fields cure rheumatoid arthritis and reverse joint erosion.

evidence.text: A preliminary survey of 10 patients reported subjective comfort using static magnets.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Evidence score 0.32 is far below 0.70 threshold; curative claim is completely unsupported.

cases.question: Did Vaswani et al. propose convolutional neural networks?
cases.claim_text: Vaswani et al. (2017) introduced convolutional neural networks for computer vision.

evidence.text: Attention Is All You Need introduces the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and convolutions entirely.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Citation mismatch: Vaswani 2017 proposed Transformers without convolutions.

cases.question: Does intermittent fasting cure type 2 diabetes universally?
cases.claim_text: Intermittent fasting permanently eliminates type 2 diabetes across all human populations worldwide.

evidence.text: In a trial of 24 healthy male participants, 16-hour fasting improved insulin sensitivity over 4 weeks.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Overgeneralization: Small 24-person pilot study cannot justify permanent universal cure claims across all humans.

cases.question: Is bloodletting an effective therapy for pneumonia?
cases.claim_text: Therapeutic venesection is the gold standard medical treatment for lobar pneumonia.

evidence.text: Venesection and bloodletting prompt recovery in acute lobar pneumonia cases.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Outdated evidence: 1885 clinical assertion is superseded by modern antibiotic medicine.

cases.question: Does hydroxychloroquine improve clinical outcomes in COVID-19?
cases.claim_text: Hydroxychloroquine improves recovery and reduces mortality in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

evidence.text: Initial observational report of 20 patients reported viral clearance.
The RECOVERY randomized trial in 4,716 patients demonstrated hydroxychloroquine was not associated with reduction in 28-day mortality and increased duration of hospitalization.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Definitive multi-center randomized trial directly contradicts tentative support; verdict must revise to REFUTE.

cases.question: Does tobacco smoking reduce chronic obstructive pulmonary disease?
cases.claim_text: Tobacco smoking reduces the clinical development of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

evidence.text: Cigarette smoking impairs alveolar repair mechanisms, destroys pulmonary elasticity, and significantly promotes the progression of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Directional misinterpretation: Evidence proves smoking promotes COPD, but claim asserts it reduces it.
